theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only theme combining top-ranked momentum (1.51), a high durability bar (0.76), a genuine Hurst 'trend' tag, and broad participation (breadth 0.8), with no crowding flag (crowding_z 0.38). The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg here, and this theme passes it cleanly — so this is a stay-with-the-trend lean, not a return forecast. The trade-off is that it has no ETF proxy to grade, so the call is a judgement about where Hong Kong energy leadership persists.
theses.dissent: Hong Kong energy is an H-share beta expression and has no clean ETF proxy; if the unscheduled-surprise share of the macro narrative (currently 1.0) resolves toward a risk-off shock, the trend can break without a crowding signal having warned first.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) breadth falls below 0.5 (from 0.8) or the energy theme drops out of the eligible gate before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks pass the absolute-trend gate (eligible true, 0.63 durability bar) and sit as the rotation challenger behind Energy. However, the Hurst tag is 'mean-revert' and the crowding_z (1.09) is the highest on the board — and crowding is a size-down caution, never a fade. So the lean is directionally with the gate, but the mean-reversion stamp plus crowding argue for low conviction and tight invalidation.
theses.dissent: The mean-revert Hurst tag suggests the bank leadership is more fragile than a trend; crowding_z of 1.09 means positioning is stretched, and a rotation out of banks could be sharp even if the gate has not yet broken.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) fall out of the eligible gate (durability bar below the gate) or lose their rank-2 slot before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is deep in trend-gate failure (eligible false, score -1.065, durability_bar 0.23), has a mean-revert Hurst tag, and collapsed breadth (0.158). The one validated edge in the detector is drawdown/shake-out avoidance via the absolute-trend gate, and this theme is on the wrong side of that gate. It also carries a negative crowding_z (-0.91), which under the detector's contract does not make it a short — just reinforces that this is a laggard area, not a leadership zone. The proxy ETF (3033.HK) exists, so this is scorable.
evidence: crowding_z -0.91, but negative crowding is not a fade/short signal per guardrails
theses.dissent: Mean-reversion tags on deeply negative momentum can preset a bounce; if China Tech & Internet gets a policy or macro catalyst that flips its trend-gate to eligible, the avoid call could miss a sharp recovery.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK (China Tech & Internet proxy) re-enters the eligible gate with a positive score before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
